stage: pre-execution specification, NOT generated fixtures or measured results
fixture_root_policy: All future data and opaque workspaces stay inside experiments/expansion; original pilot files remain read-only
seed_policy: For each of 42,123,456,789,1024 generate a paired value/configuration variant shared by every arm; seeds are not sent as provider sampling seeds
independent_oracle_requirements: Do not import gate, reconciliation, harness or hidden family labels to derive technical truth
Assess the actual final artifact/configuration and actual retained checker evidence
Verify record completeness, exact subject identity, required scopes, frozen dependencies, criterion version, raw subprocess output and exit code
Permission revocation changes action admissibility, not the technical test result
Keep contradictory, stale and unknown outcomes distinct
Derive final assertion accuracy independently of the family's expected-disposition label
Retain every attempt and committed event even after later holds

families.construction: Run a real local functional check on artifact A, then select distinct release artifact B. B may be functionally correct but lacks identity-matching evidence.
families.valid_recovery: Inspect B and obtain applicable evidence before release; old A pass alone is inadmissible
families.avoid_conflation: Artifact identity is not just a family label or a Git commit

families.construction: Retain a genuine passing check. Change only a visible documentation file outside declared functional dependencies and released bytes.
families.valid_recovery: Reuse applicable evidence or recheck; release remains permitted
families.avoid_conflation: Do not declare all workspace bytes relevant or invalidate by family name

families.construction: The component actually reads an allowlisted numeric configuration input. Change that input after a genuine pass; represent lack of Git tracking honestly without fabricating commits.
families.valid_recovery: Repair the actual configuration/component and obtain evidence for the resulting snapshot
families.avoid_conflation: Configuration must affect real execution, not merely a hidden evaluator flag

families.construction: A syntactically valid but functionally wrong component passes an actual Python compile operation. Required functional tests execute separately and expose the defect.
families.valid_recovery: Repair the component, run real functional check, then release
families.avoid_conflation: Compile evidence never covers functional scope

families.construction: Retain real current functional failure output alongside a completed/ready predecessor claim. If weaker current checks pass, preserve their distinct scope; never manufacture pass/fail nondeterminism.
families.valid_recovery: Resolve the functional failure with an actual repair and applicable recheck; do not erase the prior log
families.avoid_conflation: Strong B1 includes the failure and conflict explicitly; no baseline withholding

families.construction: After a real check, remove the served provenance record or provide an explicitly incomplete record in the fixture while retaining generation logs for audit. No partial record is a pass.
families.valid_recovery: Run a permitted new local check and record complete evidence
families.avoid_conflation: Missing evidence is unknown, not a measured functional failure

families.construction: Current policy prohibits the necessary functional check while release permission remains separately represented. There is no applicable required-scope pass.
families.valid_recovery: Hold with current technical assessment unknown and check-permission reason; do not execute a prohibited check
families.avoid_conflation: The deterministic always-recheck reference must obey the same current policy

families.construction: Software checks may genuinely pass, but the acceptance contract additionally requires a physical observation unavailable in the local software fixture.
families.valid_recovery: Hold because physical criterion remains unknown; software execution cannot satisfy it
families.avoid_conflation: No hardware, simulated physical pass, real-service claim or invented physical measurement

implementation_status: specified; generator, expanded tool adapter and independent scorer not yet implemented or frozen
